class.name: VehicleController
class.brief_description: Base train controller controlling all train systems
class.description: Base train controller node. It allows building behaviour of the train by adding child nodes of the [VehicleComponent] class. The vehicle holds its own commands and is reached by its [RailVehicleServer] handle; [member vehicle_id] is only its id (its scenery name in lower case), set by [method VehicleServer.vehicle_set_id].

method.name: add_component
method.description: Takes [param component] into the vehicle and owns it from then on - it is ticked with the vehicle and freed with it (the shape [method Node.add_child] has, for the same reason).

method.name: apply_config
method.description: Writes the vehicle's configuration into its simulation (should not be called directly)

method.name: apply_configuration
method.description: Writes the wrapper's configuration - the vehicle's and every component's - to the backend, then announces that the backend carries it.

method.name: emit_config_changed
method.description: One of this vehicle's components (re)applied its configuration.

method.name: emit_position_changed_if_needed
method.description: Emits [signal position_changed] when the vehicle has moved at least 1 m since it was last emitted.

method.name: find_components
method.description: Every component of [param type] - a vehicle has two couplers, one per end.

method.name: find_generic_components
method.description: Every scripted component carrying [param tag] - modders add as many as they like.

method.name: get_acceleration
method.description: The acceleration along the track [m/s²], every force counted ([code]AccS[/code]).

method.name: get_commands
method.description: Returns the commands this vehicle answers to.

method.name: get_component
method.description: The component of [param type], or null when this vehicle has none. One per kind: a vehicle has one brake system and one engine, whatever kind it is.

method.name: get_config
method.description: Returns a dictionary with all config properties of the train. The same as [method VehicleServer.vehicle_dump_config].

method.name: get_direction
method.description: The reverser, counted from the cab it is set in ([code]DirActive[/code]).

method.name: get_mass_total
method.description: The vehicle's whole mass [kg], its load counted ([code]TotalMass[/code]).

method.name: get_speed
method.description: How fast the vehicle moves [km/h], whichever way ([code]Vel[/code]) - straight from the backend, for the per-frame readers that want this one number.

method.name: get_state
method.description: Everything this vehicle reports about itself, by name: its own values and those of every enabled component, in one flat dictionary, composed on each call. A reader every frame takes the cached [method VehicleServer.vehicle_dump_state] instead; a reader after a single value is better served by that value's component, see [method VehicleServer.vehicle_component_get].

method.name: get_state_serial
method.description: Bumped by every step and every command - what tells a cached state dump ([method VehicleServer.vehicle_dump_state]) that it is stale.

method.name: get_total_distance
method.description: How far the vehicle has run [km] ([code]DistCounter[/code]).

method.name: get_velocity
method.description: The velocity along the vehicle's front [m/s], negative backwards ([code]V[/code]) - straight from the backend.

method.name: get_world_position
method.description: Where the vehicle is in the world, as the server that places it handed it down.

method.name: get_world_transform
method.description: The vehicle's place in the world, as the server that places it handed it down.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Brings the vehicle up: its simulation, its state and the signals whose initial value listeners expect. Called by whatever owns the vehicle, once it is built.

method.name: is_physics_active
method.description: Whether the simulation moves the vehicle - it switches a vehicle standing with nothing to do off ([code]PhysicActivation[/code]).

method.name: is_simulation_ready
method.description: Whether this vehicle's simulation exists yet. A vehicle is a vehicle from the moment it is built, but nothing can be coupled to it or read off it until the backend behind it is there.

method.name: process_components
method.description: One tick of everything the vehicle is made of, after its physics has moved, by [param delta] seconds.

method.name: register_command
method.description: Registers a command this vehicle answers to. A command registered twice is an error.

method.name: remove_component
method.description: Lets [param component] go: it leaves the vehicle and is no longer processed with it nor read into its state and configuration. What a proxy node does when it leaves the tree.

method.name: send_command
method.description: Runs a command of this vehicle and returns what its handler answered, or [code]null[/code] when the vehicle has no such command. See [method RailVehicleServer.vehicle_send_command].

method.name: set_vehicle_rid
method.description: This vehicle's handle in [VehicleServer], set when the server attaches it - what [method Resource.get_rid] answers, as a [Mesh] answers its [RenderingServer] handle.

method.name: unregister_command
method.description: Removes a command of this vehicle.

method.name: update_state
method.description: Forces update of the state (should not be called directly)

members.member: [code]Param.Category[/code] The vehicle's category (train, road, ship, airplane).
The vehicle's components as stored configuration: setting them lets go of the ones the vehicle had and takes these in, in their order ([method add_component]).
[code]Dimensions:Floor[/code] Floor height above the rail head, in meters; used to position universal cargo loads.
The name of what simulates this vehicle, as registered with [VehicleServer] ([method VehicleServer.implementation_register]) - the server hands that one the step.

The velocity the vehicle starts with [km/h], along its own front - the scenery line's velocity token. 0 leaves the vehicle not ready to depart, its battery off until switched on; any other value (0.1 for a standing but ready vehicle) turns the battery on as the FIZ says ([code]TDynamicObject::Init[/code]).
The vehicle's id - its scenery name in lower case - only for finding it ([method VehicleServer.vehicle_get_rid_by_id]).

signal.name: command_received
signal.description: Emitted when train receives a command

signal.name: position_changed
signal.description: The vehicle moved at least 1 m since this was last emitted; [param position] is where it is in the world.

signal.name: simulation_configured
signal.description: The simulation now carries the vehicle's configuration - its own and every component's.

signal.name: simulation_initialized
signal.description: The simulation behind the vehicle exists and carries its configuration.

constants.constant: The reverser set forward - forward from the cab it is set in.
